description: WebKitGTK (Even simulator) has crossOriginIsolated=true but no SharedArrayBuffer and no OPFS; Turso's worker spawn throws DataCloneError as an unhandled rejection so connect() hangs until the 10s timeout. Pre-check SAB + OPFS (and sync access handles) before loading Turso so launch falls straight to IndexedDB. In dev builds show a platform marker: which platform (simulator / Even app / browser), what's available (COI, SAB, OPFS, sync handles, WebGPU, WASM threads, WebCodecs), the backing DB and blob store, and fallback reasons.
title: Skip Turso fast where it can't run; dev-mode platform/storage markers
